description: Election Commission - Declare that D. M. A. Disanayaka as a member of the Medirigiriya P/S
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Medirigiriya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and the formal declaration of a new member to fill the vacancy. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
